title: Group algebras that are domains but embed in no division ring
description: We answer Problem 1.5 of the Kourovka Notebook for group algebras over fields of every positive characteristic. For each prime p we construct a finitely presented, torsion-free, word-hyperbolic diffuse group Γ_p. Its group algebra is a domain over every field. There is a nonidentity element w_p that every homomorphism from Γ_p to the units of a division ring of characteristic p sends to 1. The obstruction comes from matrices. Finite-field interpolation bounds their total rank from above, while averaging over permutations of free generators gives a contradictory lower bound if certain group elements remain distinct. A second construction gives a retraction and allows us to combine the obstructions for different primes. In one three-generated diffuse group, a single central element of infinite order dies in every division ring of positive characteristic and in every finite-dimensional linear representation over a field. Lean 4 verifies the nonembedding conclusions for the two prime-specific group algebras.
notes: Preprint. It has not been peer reviewed. Answers Kourovka Problem 1.5 (Bokut') for group algebras over fields of every positive characteristic, with word-hyperbolic groups. Version 2.0.0 adds Theorem D: one three-generated diffuse group with a central element of infinite order killed in every division ring of positive characteristic and in every finite-dimensional linear representation, and the corresponding central localization of its group algebra (domains with no homomorphism to a division ring were known earlier, from Leavitt and Cohn; the new point is a group algebra, uniformly in the characteristic). The integral and characteristic-zero versions and Mal'cev's problem remain open. The Lean 4 verification of the nonembedding clauses of Theorems A and B (folder lean/) is unchanged from version 1.1.0. Text: CC BY 4.0. Build script and Lean sources: MIT or Apache 2.0.
